title: Welcome to my webpage!
text:
Most of my political science work can be placed in one of the three bins:


Voter-level populism
Since 2020, I have been a member of the project called “Populism’s Roots: Economic and Cultural Explanations in Democracies of Europe (PRECEDE)”. This project focussed on understanding voter-level populism, how it can be explained and what it can tells us about the recent rise of populism in Europe.


COVID-19 Policy Response
I was part of the COVID-19 Policy Response Lab, which examined the differences in the ways different governments responded to the COVID-19 pandemic.


Electoral institutions and behavioral effects
Most of my work in the studies of electoral institutions focussed on understanding the process behind electoral coordination.
